frames: 480 px tiles of the output frame, made 2026-11-10 by `make godot-look` and `make godot-capture` on Metal (images are not kept in the repo)

shots.evidence: Bottom quarter (dune ground) is flat black; Wanderer readable, no Colossus in view, horizon fog plausible.
Bottom 15-20% (ground wedge) is flat black; Wanderer visible at left edge, fog fine.
Wanderer centred, dark ground strip is brown with texture, fog thins upward; no Colossus in view.
Wanderer large and readable against haze, ground strip not flat black, sky-to-fog gradient intact; no Colossus in view.
Colossus body, head and eye glints readable against dark haze; whole frame is dim but has a lit body and a dark end.
Bottom ~20% (ground) is flat black; Wanderer and fog gradient fine.
Readable, fog thicker near ground. Thin black streak at right mid-ground and white patch at bottom right are odd but not a rubric item.
Hazier, Wanderer and horizon mound still readable, fog thickest at ground and thinning up.
Clear air, sun glow, mound and horizon sharp; ground dark gradient with small Wanderer silhouette at bottom, still readable. No Colossus visible even with no fog.
Dense fog, near white-out but graded, Wanderer readable at bottom; no hard band or hole.
Dark by design, sun glow, mound and Wanderer at bottom still readable.
Bright with a hot sun spot only, Wanderer and ground gradient readable, no large flat white area.
No Colossus silhouette anywhere, only a smooth mound at left horizon; bottom ~30% dune ground is flat black.
Bottom 15-20% ground wedge is flat black; Wanderer visible at left, no Colossus in view.
Colossus leg and torso textured and clear against grey sky, Wanderer visible on the knee.
Only Colossus surface texture fills the frame; no Wanderer figure anywhere.
Colossus body and head glints recognisable in dark haze, centre of frame.
Colossus silhouette with eye glint against lit horizon haze, fog thicker at ground.
Fallen Colossus silhouette and debris against bright haze, horizon plausible.
Deliberate fade, exempt from exposure; frame shows a dark vertical slab, no UI.
No Colossus visible, only a horizon mound; bottom ~30% dune ground is flat black. Frame matches shot-1.

notes: Shots 1-4 and the fog and intensity frames show no Colossus even with fog 0; colossus-readable was judged not applicable there.
Flat black ground in the low-dune frames (shot-1, shot-2, fog_height-0, 1-approach, 2-approach-low-hero, 9-next-colossus) is the main systematic failure.
